items.exampleEn: He sentimentally kept every letter his wife had ever written to him.
items.exampleZh: 他念舊地保留了妻子寫給他的每一封信。
items.glossZh: 感傷念舊地；多愁善感地

items.exampleEn: The rain fell monotonously on the roof all afternoon.
items.exampleZh: 雨整個下午單調地落在屋頂上。

items.exampleEn: The insubordinate player was left out of the next match.
items.exampleZh: 那名不服從指示的球員被排除在下一場比賽之外。

items.exampleEn: The boy grinned impishly and hid behind the door.
items.exampleZh: 那個男孩頑皮地咧嘴一笑，躲到門後。

items.exampleEn: This author writes prolifically, finishing three novels a year.
items.exampleZh: 這位作家創作量驚人，一年寫完三本小說。

items.exampleEn: The company hypocritically talks about nature while polluting the river.
items.exampleZh: 那家公司一邊汙染河川，一邊虛偽地大談保護自然。

items.exampleEn: Our neighbor decorates his house eccentrically, with old bicycles on the roof.
items.exampleZh: 我們的鄰居把房子裝飾得很古怪，屋頂上擺著舊腳踏車。

items.exampleEn: The team returned victoriously from the final.

items.sentenceEn: He spoke sentimentally about the town where he grew up.
items.sentenceZh: 他感傷地談起自己長大的那個小鎮。

items.audioEn: The flat desert road stretched on monotonously for hours.
items.audioZh: 平坦的沙漠公路單調地綿延了好幾個小時。
items.questionZh: 那條沙漠公路是什麼樣子？
options: It had a lot of sharp, narrow turns.
It was flat and the same for hours.
It was crowded with big, noisy trucks.
It was closed for repairs all day.

items.sentenceEn: He repeated the same sentence monotonously, like a robot.
items.sentenceZh: 他像機器人一樣，單調地重複同一句話。

items.sentenceEn: Mozart composed music prolifically from a very young age.
items.sentenceZh: 莫札特從很小的時候就大量創作音樂。

items.stemEn: He dressed ____, with a purple hat and bright green boots.
items.stemZh: 他穿得很古怪，戴紫色帽子、穿亮綠色靴子。

items.stemEn: The ____ pupil kept talking back to the teacher, so he was sent to the head teacher's office.
items.stemZh: 那個不服從的學生一直跟老師頂嘴，所以被送到校長室。

items.passageEn: My great-uncle Felix was a painter who worked prolifically, producing over two thousand paintings. He also dressed eccentrically, often wearing two different shoes. As a young art student, he was considered insubordinate because he refused to copy the paintings of the old masters, and his teachers did not value his individuality. He hated art that was done monotonously, like painting the same bowl of fruit every day. Late in life, he talked sentimentally about those student years. He sometimes criticized rich collectors, though some said he did so hypocritically, since he had sold them many paintings himself. On his ninetieth birthday, he smiled impishly and announced that he was starting a new series. When it opened, he walked victoriously through the crowded hall.
items.passageZh: 我的伯公 Felix 是位多產的畫家，畫了兩千多幅作品。他的穿著也很古怪，常常左右腳穿不同的鞋。年輕時讀美術學校，他因為不肯臨摹古代大師的畫，被認為不服從，老師們也不重視他的個人特色。他討厭一成不變的創作，例如每天畫同一盤水果。晚年時，他感傷地談起那段學生時光。他有時會批評有錢的收藏家，不過也有人說他這樣很虛偽，因為他自己就賣了很多畫給他們。九十歲生日那天，他頑皮地笑著說要開始畫一系列新作品。這系列作品展出時，他得意地走過擠滿人潮的展覽廳。

questions.questionZh: Felix 年輕時為什麼被認為不服從？
Felix 九十歲生日那天說了什麼？
options: 要開始畫一系列新作品
要把所有畫作捐給市立美術館
要搬到海邊的小村莊安度晚年

items.promptZh: 她虛偽地批評別人亂花錢，自己卻每天叫外送。
referenceEn: She hypocritically criticizes others for wasting money, yet she orders food delivery every day.
She hypocritically blames other people for wasting money, but she has food delivered every day.
rubricZh: 「虛偽地」用副詞 hypocritically，位置例如動詞前（hypocritically criticizes）、句中其他適當位置 等
「叫外送」可寫，例如 orders food delivery、has food delivered 等；說的是習慣，時態配合內容

items.instructionZh: 用 impishly 造一個句子，描述某個人或動物頑皮地做某件事。
referenceEn: My niece impishly hid my glasses in the fridge.
The kitten looked at me impishly before it pushed my cup off the table.
rubricZh: impishly 是副詞，修飾動作（例如 impishly hid、looked at me impishly）
內容要說出頑皮的行為
時態配合內容（例如 hid、looked）
